edits.before: Leona wins the level 1-2 lane because her E is a point-and-click gap-close stun that fires before Alistar can walk into his telegraphed W-Q range, letting her open every trade on her terms. Alistar can only react, and any time he steps up to engage he risks eating her lockup first, so he plays for scaling rather than contesting the early all-in.

edits.before: Through 3-6 Leona keeps the initiative: her Zenith Blade E gives her the longer, more reliable engage, and at 6 her Solar Flare plus E chain is a guaranteed pick that outranges Alistar's flash W-Q setup.
